title: 可解释的以表头为中心的大规模语义表格解释与数据质量评估框架
summary: 提出以表头为中心的可解释框架，在仅有元数据时进行列类型标注与数据质量评估，将表头映射到39种可解释类型并保留词级溯源，通过数据质量问题分类触发验证规则，聚合为HeadersIQ质量指标，在约12万表头列上验证了实用性。
summary_en: Presents an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation and Data Quality Assessment, mapping headers to 39 interpretable types with token-level traceability, activating validation rules from a Data Quality Issue taxonomy, and aggregating into HeadersIQ, evaluated on ~120,000 header columns across heterogeneous benchmarks.
